answer.rationale: Regional failover is proven effective (memory_b2: clean traffic shift, latency recovery within minutes during similar degradation). Current constraints: (1) p99 write latency at 5x target in primary only, (2) security patch cannot be reverted, (3) settlement peak with heavy writes. Rollback is blocked. Add capacity takes time we don't have. Circuit breaker risks write loss during peak settlement. Route read replicas helps dashboard/reporting, not write path. Failover to secondary region isolates the primary degradation, keeps the mandatory security patch live, preserves all customer writes during settlement peak, and has direct precedent. Preserves uncertainty because we don't know the root cause yet; failover buys time for investigation without customer impact.
